title: 3D Snapshot Colorway Options | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Colorways in CLO 2025.0 allows you to select the desired colorway when taking a 3D snapshot.

Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio

summary: ```markdown # 3D Snapshot Colorway Options | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe, and I'm going to show you a really cool update we have with our Snapshot for the 2025.0 update. So let's dive on in and have some fun while we learn. ## File Export Options Okay, so what's really cool here is now when you go to **File** > **Export**, or no, sorry, **File** > **Snapshot** > **3D Window**, I’m going to have colorway improvements. ## Snapshot Views I'm going to say **Save**. You can choose between **Multi-View** or **Single View**. Both Single and Multi-View have this update. If you wanted to do Single, you can do this. ## Colorway Options The cool update here is this **Colorway** option. In the Colorway section, I could choose **Current All**, which would include all my colorways, or **Custom**. This will then allow me to choose exactly which colorways I want to export out in my Snapshot. ### Customizing Colorways Here, I can go through and decide, like, “Oh, I wanted these, but not the white.” Then I can hit **Okay** and save. ## Multi-View Colorway Customization I can also do the same with Multi-View. Here, I have my Multi-View displayed, right? I can also go right over here where it says **Colorway**, and I already have the custom option selected. I can always go back and check my custom settings using this little dropdown to edit the colorway. ### Reviewing Selected Colorways With the Colorway edit feature, I can see what I've chosen, what I wanted, and what I didn't want. I'm just going to say **Select All**, hit **Okay**, and then I can hit **Save**. I’ll see all of my colorways in all my viewpoints and everything, and it'll be really, really cool. ## Conclusion Okay, cool! Thank you all so much for watching. I hope you enjoyed this update. If you have any questions, use that comment section down below. Don't forget to like and subscribe, and check out all of our great Clo videos on our YouTube channel. There’s so much great information out there. Thanks again for watching! Keep having fun in Clo. Bye, bye, bye, bye! ```
